messages:
noel: Heads up - noticed a weird gap this morning: several SCIM deprovision jobs show as SUCCESS in audit but KMS envelope rewraps failed. Some tenants report stale access still active.
rachel.idp: Saw a spike of SAML validation errors around the same window. Our IDP hosts had clock drift ~3-5m compared to authn server.
vikram: Do you have an example log?
noel: Paste: `2026-03-23T03:07:21Z provisioner.INFO Deprovision completed user=alice@orchard org=orchard action=deprov audit_id=aud-5543` then shortly after: `2026-03-23T03:07:22Z provisioner.ERROR KMSRewrapFailed user=alice@orchard err="DecryptFailed: invalid_ciphertext"` Audit shows success but rewrap did not complete.
kms-bot: KMS rotation job started at 2026-03-23T03:00:00Z for envelope_alias=env-2026-03-23-03.
rachel.idp: SAML trace for one affected session: `SAML validation failed: ConditionsNotMet NotBefore=2026-03-23T02:55:00Z now=2026-03-23T02:59:10Z` (clock skew ~4m10s). Some downstream flows use assertion timestamps to select rotation buckets.
vikram: Ah - deprovision code picks rotation_bucket = floor(assertion_time / 3600) when choosing which envelope to rotate. If assertion_time is skewed it may try to use a different envelope alias that was already rotated -> decrypt of old ciphertext fails.
oncall-sre: Immediate mitigation options: 1) pause KMS rotation for 30m and retry failed deprovs, 2) add guard in provisioner to verify envelope metadata exists before marking audit success and retry rewrap synchronously, 3) roll back any rotation that started during the skew window (painful).
noel: I'm going to pause rotation for 30m and kick off a retry job for deprovs that had audit success but KMS errors. Running query: `SELECT id, user, org, audit_id FROM provisioning_jobs WHERE status='success' AND rewrap_status!='ok' AND created_at > now() - interval '6 hours';`
vikram: Long-term fix: don't derive envelope identifiers solely from assertion time. Use stable user-scoped envelope_id (user.kms_envelope_id) stored on profile and rotate using that id. Also make audit save atomic with rewrap (only mark success after rewrap ok).
rachel.idp: Also enforce NTP on all idp hosts and add a CI check that simulates 5m clock skew for assertion handling.
oncall-sre: Paused rotation window 03:00-03:30 UTC. Suppressing paging for scim-kms-decrypt-errors for 60m.
deploy-bot: Deploy queued: provisioner patch v2026.03.23-deprov-atomic -> canary.
noel: Canary run: retried 6 affected deprovs with new patch, rewrap succeeded 6/6, audit entries reconciled.
kms-bot: Rewrap audit: created new envelope pointers for 6 users referencing existing key material (no re-encrypt performed), migration tags: {migration_author: "noel", migration_ticket: "ENGSEC-2100"}.
vikram: Postmortem actions: - ENGSEC-2100: decouple envelope selection from assertion timestamp and persist stable envelope_id per user - enforce atomic audit+rewrap in provisioner - global NTP/chrony enforcement on identity fleet - add contract tests that exercise KMS rotations during small clock skews
rachel.idp: Added runbook draft: https://confluence.internal/redwood/idp-ntp-rewrap-runbook (draft).
oncall-sre: I'll keep suppression 60m, monitor metrics for 4h. If looks good we'll remove suppression and mark resolved.
noel: Filing follow-ups and scheduling a short retro with infra/idp/platsec. Will close thread once prod sweep/verification completes. Thanks all :thumbsup:
